homePage.seoTitle: Mysterria - Lord of the Mysteries Minecraft Server
homePage.heroTagline: Drink the potion. Act the role. Climb from Sequence 9 toward godhood - before the Fog claims you.
homePage.circleTitle: Every power in the novel. Playable.
homePage.circleLede: Our custom plugin implements the full Beyonder power system - 22 pathways, potions, rituals, acting, and loss of control. No mods required; a client-side companion adds the visuals.
homePage.circleStepOneBody: Loot refilling chests, trade with players, or hunt mystical creatures for a Sequence 9 potion formula from any of the 22 pathways.
homePage.circleStepTwoBody: Gather the main ingredients, work the cauldron, and swallow your fate. Real abilities, spirituality costs - and real madness if you rush.
homePage.closingLede: Free to join. Java 26.1.2+, accept the resource pack, and your first Sequence is about an evening away.

commissions.pageSubtitle: Submit a spell rework request using your available commission slots.

terms.title: Magic System Commission
terms.whatIsIt: A custom development service that lets magic practitioners request focused, lore-accurate tweaks to existing spells, mechanics, or abilities – reviewed by our testers and developers, then implemented directly by our engineering team.
requestOptions: A shared budget of 6 points per request – a Major Change costs 3 points, a Minor Change costs 1.
Up to 2 Major Changes – a full lore alignment rewrite, a balance rework of one ability, or one new spell/scaling addition.
Up to 6 Minor Changes – small numeric tweaks (cooldown, damage, mana cost, scaling constants) or small lore-flavor edits, across one or several spells/abilities.
Mix and match within budget – e.g. 1 Major + 3 Minor uses the full 6 points, same as 2 Major or 6 Minor alone.
requirements: Justified – explain the gameplay or lore reasoning behind it.
Lore-accurate – grounded in established setting/source material, not invented from scratch.
Non-fundamental – no core system reworks or architecture changes.

Considerate of recent work – don't request a redo of a spell/ability that was reworked recently and is currently in good, balanced shape just for a different take. If it's genuinely become unbalanced, outdated, or broken since – regardless of who touched it last – that's fair game to request.
howItWorksSteps: Testers and developers review it for feasibility and lore accuracy (Staff Verification).
Approved requests are scheduled and implemented.
terms.note: Requests that don't fit these bounds will be scoped into multiple commissions – we'll tell you exactly how many before anything is charged further.

rung.title: Sequence {n}: {name}
rung.start: Where every Beyonder begins. The first potion needs no ritual and costs no Madness.
rung.digest: You reach it by acting out your current role until its potion is digested, then brewing the next one. Rituals matter more with every step.
rung.demigod: The last Sequence open to everyone. Every seat above it is limited.
rung.seats: Only {count} Beyonders of this Pathway can hold it at once. When it’s full, a seat war decides who does.
rung.throne: The Pathway’s god: one throne, held by one player until they stop playing or the season ends.
rung.full: Every ability of this Sequence, in full

progression.title: From potion to power

discover.title: Find the formula
discover.copy: Every Pathway starts from a written formula, and its ingredients are scattered across the world.

brew.title: Brew the potion
brew.copy: Build a Magic Cauldron and add the ingredients in the formula's order. Get the order wrong and the brew fails.

drink.title: Drink the potion
drink.copy: One swallow and you're a Beyonder of the {pathway} Pathway. The first potion asks for no ritual and costs no Madness.

formula.label: Sequence 9 formula: {sequence}
formula.detail: {pathway} formula: main ingredients left, supplementary right.

cauldron.label: Magic Cauldron
cauldron.detail: Follow the formula’s ingredient order. Failed brews keep your ingredients.

sequencePotion.label: {sequence} potion
sequencePotion.detail: Sequence 9 potion. Expires after two real-time days.

drinkPotion.label: First potion
drinkPotion.detail: Your first potion needs no ritual and costs no Madness.

book.sealLabel: {pathway} Sequence 9 formula. Requires a Magic Cauldron.

drink.about: Every Pathway climbs ten Sequences, from 9 up to its god at 0. Each potion you digest takes you a step higher, and the higher ones also demand rituals.

progression.boonNote: A Boon rides beside a Pathway and never ahead of it, so every Boon-bearer starts here, with a potion of their own. The Fool shows how.

pantheon.title: Become a god
pantheon.body: Each of the 22 Pathways has one throne at Sequence 0. Reach it and you become that Pathway's god, with a title above your head and a spell no other player has.
pantheon.rule: No one can take a throne by force. It only passes on when its god stops playing, and every throne opens again when the season ends.

climb.title: Climb to Sequence 1
climb.body: Seats above Sequence 4 are limited. When a rung is full, you win your seat in a seat war.

prove.title: Prove yourself
prove.body: Hold your Pathway's Uniqueness, lead a congregation and earn legendary deeds. One of them is a public event that plays out your Pathway's role from the novel.

brew.title: Brew the last potion
brew.body: Three Sequence 1 Characteristics of your Pathway, and nothing else. It can't be drunk: only the rite consumes it.

vigil.title: Declare and keep the vigil
vigil.body: The whole server is told. For 72 hours, any rival at Sequence 1 may contest your claim.

rite.title: The rite
rite.body: Everyone gets ten minutes' warning and the coordinates. Witnesses earn acting, and the site stays marked on the map for good.

incursions.title: PvP with real stakes
incursions.body: The open world is safe. When 50 or more players are online, Cosmos Incursions open PvP zones at random spots on the live map, and a zone's colour tells you what you risk by dying there.
incursions.tiersLabel: Zone colours and what dying costs

green.name: Green
green.stake: Drop an item or two. Damage is evened out, so a new Beyonder can still win.

yellow.name: Yellow
yellow.stake: Drop more items. Damage is only partly evened out.

red.name: Red
red.stake: Drop everything you carry. Raw power decides.

black.name: Black
black.stake: Lose to a player and you can lose a Sequence or half your acting.

incursions.permanent: Some zones never close. Loot their points of interest, then hold an extraction point long enough to escape with it.
incursions.logout: Logging out won't save you. Your body stays behind, defenceless.

arena.title: Mythic Bedwars, Duels and FFA
arena.body: Matches are announced in chat: click to join and keep playing until you're pulled in. Everyone starts as a random Pathway at Sequence 9 and climbs by buying Arcane Elixirs mid-match.
arena.safe: Your real character is never at risk, and what you win carries over to it: acting progress, shorter cooldowns, bottles and tokens.

rifts.title: Rifts and dungeons
rifts.body: Rifts stand in the open world as pillars of shifting light. The whole server pours Energy Fragments into one until it gives way to a dungeon, and inside you get one life.

tank.name: Tank
tank.body: Takes the hits and draws aggro. Can't cast.

archer.name: Archer
archer.body: Far stronger arrows, weaker up close.

rifts.guardians: Guardians roam the open world and enrage below 30% health. Bring magic for the end, because below 20% nothing else hurts them. Each kill drops a token you spin for rare loot, Characteristics included.
rifts.alt: A swirling Rift between floating runestones in a ruined tower

churches.title: Churches
churches.body: At Sequence 4 you can found a church by placing its core in the world. Branches carry it across the map and its members' prayer strengthens its perks. Rival churches go to war over each other's cores and vaults.
churches.honorific: Write your Honorific Name, a five-line invocation of who you are, and other players can chant it to reach you through a ritual.
churches.alt: A black and crimson cathedral under the stars

anchors.title: Outer Gods Anchors
anchors.body: An Outer God's seed takes root somewhere in the world, dropping only hints in chat for a day. Then it blooms into alien terrain guarded by its defenders. Wear it down together, then break its heart.
anchors.boons: Your contribution buys rewards, including shards of rare Boons: a second Sequence borrowed from an Outer God and raised by sacrifice.

companion.title: COI Client
companion.lede: Our own optional mod gives Minecraft a full Beyonder interface. Every mechanic still works without it.

hotkeys.title: Cast at speed:
hotkeys.body: Bind abilities to hotkeys or a 16-slot wheel.

visuals.title: See the magic:
visuals.body: Ritual circles and casting effects, drawn in full.

madness.title: Feel the madness:
madness.body: Whispers and hallucinations creep in as your sanity slips.

perks.title: Act faster:
perks.body: 2% more acting from every source and 5% shorter acting cooldowns.

ordeals.title: Losing control isn’t the end
ordeals.body: From Sequence 6 up, a Beyonder who loses control is no longer deleted. You’re thrown into an Ordeal instead, and how you play it decides how much of your progress you keep.
ordeals.limit: Lose control a third time within 14 days and the character is gone for good. Below Sequence 6 it still is.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.body: Ninety seconds as a mutated Warden. A higher kill score means a smaller fall.

hollowing.name: Hollowing
hollowing.body: Hours as a wandering spirit, looking for a Wild Beyonder body to take.

sealing.name: Sealing
sealing.body: Locked away for days. Hunting monsters under a rising moon shortens the sentence.

pact.title: A Sequence on loan
pact.body: A Boon is a Sequence an Outer God lends you. It sits beside your own Pathway with its own spells and its own acting, and it raises your Spirituality. The wiki won't even name who grants it.
pact.rule: You can hold one Boon at a time, and it climbs only as far as your own Pathway has.
pact.alt: An Outer God's red eye torn open in the sky, a beam of light falling from it onto a tower by the sea

earned.title: Be of use to it
earned.body: Your first Boon is a reward: for events, the Battle Pass, testing or spreading the word. Aeon, Sublunary and Edict come only as shards from the Outer Gods Anchors.

altar.title: Raise an altar
altar.body: Build a Sacrificial Altar. Any tier works, and a higher one gives better results.

offering.title: Make your offering
offering.body: Sacrifice Beyonder ingredients from the Sequence you're reaching for, or lower. Weak offerings won't buy a strong rung.

refused.title: Never outgrow your Pathway
refused.body: If an offering would lift your Boon above your own Sequence, it's refused, and everything you've offered toward it is lost.

helpPage.title: Help
helpPage.lede: Answers to the questions players ask most on Discord.
helpPage.seoDescription: How to link your Minecraft account, top up, vote, catch events, open a ticket and appeal a ban on Mysterria.

linking.title: Link your Minecraft account
linking.intro: Linking connects your website account to your character in game. You need it to buy in the store and to claim the daily bonus, and it gives you the Verified role on Discord.
steps: Sign in on this site with Discord and open your profile.
Press Generate Code. The code has 8 characters and lasts 10 minutes. A new code replaces the old one.
Join the server and type `/verify <code>`. Typing `/verify` on its own opens a window to paste the code into.
Discord sends you a message when it works, and your profile stops offering a code.
linking.offline: Offline accounts can't play until they link. Register once with `/register <password> <password>`, then use `/login <password>` each time you join. Official accounts skip this.

trouble.detail: Your account is already linked. The button only shows until you link.
It expired or a newer code replaced it. Generate a fresh one and use it within 10 minutes.

Your progress in game is safe, but the site keeps the name you linked with and can't change it. Open a ticket in the Account category and staff will unlink you so you can link again. Until then, store deliveries and top-ups use your old name.
A Minecraft account can be linked to one website account only. If the wrong one is linked, or yours is already taken, open a ticket in the Account category.
To play one character on both, link your Java and Bedrock accounts through GeyserMC first, then link that account here. Separate accounts that aren't linked count as alts.

linking.geyserLink: Link Java and Bedrock on GeyserMC

topUps.title: Top up your balance
topUps.intro: The store sells in Marks, and you buy Marks through Buy Me a Coffee. 1 USD buys 40 Marks and 1 EUR buys 44.
steps: Sign in and link your Minecraft account first. Payments are matched to the name you linked.
Press your balance at the top of the site, then Top Up Balance.
On Buy Me a Coffee, put your in-game nickname in the name field, exactly as it is in game. The message isn't used to find you.
Pay the amount you want on your balance. The Marks are added automatically once the payment goes through.
topUps.miss: A name that doesn't match an account gets nothing, and staff are alerted. Open a ticket in the Payment / Donation Issue category with the name you paid under, the amount, the currency and the time. The owner checks it and adds the Marks by hand.
topUps.renamed: Changed your Minecraft name? Pay under the name you linked with until staff relink you.
topUps.donatello: On the Ukrainian version of the site the button opens Donatello instead, with your nickname already filled in.

vote.title: Vote for the server
vote.intro: Votes earn Brilliant Emporium Points, which you spend in `/emporium`. Each site takes one vote from you every 24 hours.
steps: Type `/vote` in game, or open a site below.
Enter your in-game name exactly as it is. Bedrock names start with a dot.
vote.notCount: The name has to belong to a player who has already joined the server, spelled exactly as in game. A second vote on the same site within 24 hours doesn't count either.
vote.more: Emporium points also come from the daily login streak and from bug reports.

events.title: Events and schedule
events.intro: Most events start on their own once enough players are online, so there is no fixed timetable. The server announces them in chat before they begin.

rows.detail: Every 5 hours, if at least 40 players are online. Warnings come 60, 30 and 10 minutes before. Type `/bedwars` to see when the next one is. Rewards are capped at 8 bundles a day.

Starts when 50 or more players are online, at most once every 5 hours. It lasts 30 minutes after a 3-minute countdown. If you log off inside, a Hollow stays in your place for 5 minutes. Results are posted in #events on Discord.

The server tries to plant one about every 3 days, give or take 12 hours, when at least 5 players are online. None start between 02:00 and 08:00 server time. An anchor incubates for about a day, with hints in chat every 30 minutes.
One modifier a day, on a weekly rotation of seven. `/coi tide calendar` shows the next 14 days.
Build competitions, tournaments, quizzes and treasure hunts are announced in #announcements on Discord, each with its own rules. Event shops close on the date given there.

epochs.title: Epochs
epochs.intro: An epoch is one run of the world. When it ends, the server wipes: the map and all player progress start over, and website links are cleared, so everyone links again.
epochs.now: Epoch I ended on {end}. Epoch II, the current one, opened on {start}.
epochs.next: No end date for Epoch II has been announced. Wipes don't follow a fixed calendar, so watch #announcements on Discord.
epochs.carry: Little carries over. Prizes that do say so when they're given. Last time, Server Slam rewards and a reward for Uniqueness holders carried into Epoch II.

support.title: Support, reports and appeals
support.intro: Support runs through tickets on our Discord server. Questions about how the game works are often answered faster in the guide or on the wiki.
steps: Open #create-ticket, or #створити-заявку for help in Ukrainian.
Pick the category that fits and describe what happened. Add names and times, with screenshots if you have them.

categories.detail: Something in the game or on the site is broken.
A new Minecraft name, a wrong link or another account problem.
Marks that didn't arrive, or another payment problem.
You think a ban should be lifted or shortened.
A complaint about a member of staff. It goes to the owner.

support.appealTitle: Appeal a ban or a mute
support.appealIntro: Punishments are counted in warnings, and each warning expires 6 months after it's given. Reaching 8 active warnings means a permanent ban from the server and Discord, and expiry doesn't undo it.
appealSteps: Open a ticket. For a ban, choose Ban appeal.
Say what you were punished for and when, and why it should change.
An admin who wasn't involved reviews it and can reduce or lift your warnings. Reductions and unbans are posted publicly, and the decision is final.
support.lost: Items are restored only after a confirmed server fault, such as a crash or a void bug. Open a ticket with the time and what you lost.
support.rulesLink: Warnings and bans in the rules
